GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.76 (21 Dec 45) CIS
(SCAPIN - 466)
APO 500
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Suspension of Newspaper Ise Shimbun.
1． The Japanese Imperial Government will issue the necessary orders to suspend publication of the daily newspaper ISE SHIMBUN.
2． This suspension is to be effective as of 0001 hours, 27 December 1945 and ending 2400 hours 28 December 1945.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
